decisions.answer: Image Annotator; https://github.com/thanh-taro/image-annotator

decisions.question: Minor spec defaults from review round 1
decisions.answer: Decided by orchestrator (balanced, non-product): text click ends edit/edits existing, tool stays; step diameter 2x text size; outline pairing per RULE-07; disable padding over limit; undo-back still unexported; export 1.5 s for 14.7 MP; zoom keys Shift+1/Shift+0; [ ] for reorder; keyboard multi-select limited to select all

decisions.question: Style direction
decisions.answer: Same Workbench style; portal tokens reused exactly; add image-editor roles only

decisions.question: Layout
decisions.answer: Top toolbar + right style panel; bottom sheet on narrow

decisions.question: Design tool
decisions.answer: Claude Design canvas, sibling conventions

decisions.question: Layout widths: wide/compact/narrow thresholds for Toolbar and Status bar (D1 R3-1)
decisions.answer: Three steps by the tool's own width: wide >= 1000 px; compact 800-999 px (one row, Open image and Download icon-only, status bar hides image size); narrow < 800 px (two-row toolbar, bottom sheet). D1 closes after one extra UI check on Toolbar and Status bar (owner consent past round limit).

decisions.question: Step badges: thin contrast outline, or none?
decisions.answer: none: badges as designed (owner)

decisions.question: Text tool click outside the canvas (in the surround): do nothing, clamp inside, or show while typing? (F-005 review M2)
decisions.answer: nothing: a text-tool click outside the canvas does nothing (owner)

decisions.question: Narrow summary bar: show COPY-redact.not_secure_short for blur and pixelate? (security F-007 m4)
decisions.answer: show: the bar shows the Not secure tag after the kind for blur and pixelate (owner)

decisions.question: Shift + marquee: add to the selection or replace it? (F-008 review gap 5)
decisions.answer: add: Shift + drag a box adds to the selection (owner)

decisions.answer: draw new frame: while the frame covers the whole image, a drag inside it draws a new frame (owner)

decisions.answer: Add the heading

decisions.question: Tab order: image before style panel?
decisions.answer: Image before panel

decisions.answer: Accept as is

decisions.question: Catalog category?
decisions.answer: Both developer and media, via a portal change (INV-07); ships as developer until then

decisions.question: Picking a drawing tool: clear the selection?
decisions.answer: Clear it; the select tool keeps it (owner's manual test)

decisions.question: Highlight handles on the drawn mark's edge?
decisions.answer: Handles on the drawn mark's box so thin highlights can be resized (owner's manual test)

decisions.question: Drawing colour across tools?
decisions.answer: One shared colour; highlight and redaction keep theirs

decisions.question: Select tool panel colours?
decisions.answer: Keep canvas background, add a Canvas heading

decisions.question: Select tool, nothing selected: which colour do the panel swatches set?
options: drawing colour row plus background row
decisions.recommendation: drawing colour row plus background row
decisions.answer: Drawing colour row first, then the Canvas heading with padding and background (owner: 'the color picker reset to red. Fix it.')

decisions.question: When do custom colour and sizes land?
decisions.answer: Next version 1.1; ship 1.0.0 as rc.4 after the hand checks

decisions.question: How is a custom colour picked?
decisions.answer: Palette plus a Custom swatch opening the browser colour picker; annotations only, not the background

decisions.question: How are custom sizes set?
decisions.answer: S/M/L presets plus a number field in pixels, slider on wide layouts; text, step, pen, highlight, shape, line and arrow

decisions.question: How does a rectangle or ellipse get a fill colour?
decisions.answer: Own fill colour: palette plus custom swatch, separate from the outline colour; fill stays none/solid/translucent; default fill colour is the outline colour

decisions.question: How does a text get a background?
decisions.answer: Background box behind the text: none/solid/translucent with its own colour (palette plus custom), padding and rounded corners; the text outline is dropped while a background shows; default none

decisions.question: Which version ships fill colours and text backgrounds?
